description: This walk takes you along a section of the Pembrokeshire Coast Path from Porthgain to the lovely beach at Whitesands Bay. The route follows a fine coastal path for a distance of just over 9 miles. The trail passes the blue flag beach at Abereiddy and the fabulous St David's Head before coming to the popular beach. On the way there are some wonderful cliff top views, lots of wildlife and interesting rock formations to see. You can continue your walking from Porthgain on the Porthgain to Abercastle Coastal Walk .
